title: Tangy Frozen Yoghurt
summary: Thick strained whole-milk yoghurt sweetened with sugar and golden syrup, churned into tangy soft-serve swirls and topped with fresh berries.
equipment: sieve lined with a triple layer of muslin
piping bag with large star nozzle (optional)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Strain the yoghurt
steps.text: Set the muslin-lined sieve over the bowl, add the yoghurt, cover and refrigerate for 8-12 h until about 300 ml of whey has dripped out. Discard the whey; if much more than that drained, stir a little back in. Less water means fewer ice crystals.

steps.title: Sweeten
steps.text: Tip the thick yoghurt into a clean bowl and whisk in the sugar, golden syrup and salt for 2-3 min, until the sugar no longer feels gritty. The syrup keeps the texture smooth.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for 1 h so the mixture goes into the machine very cold.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 20-30 min, until it holds swirls like soft serve.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pipe or spoon tall swirls into bowls and top with the raspberries and blueberries right away. For firmer scoops, freeze in the container for up to 2 h first.

tips: Use full-fat yoghurt: low-fat versions freeze icy.
Start the straining the evening before.
Leftovers freeze hard; soften for 15 min in the fridge before scooping.
storage: Best eaten on the day. Keep leftovers frozen and covered for up to 1 week.
